items.headline: Great Barrier Reef coral cover holds steady, signaling recovery from 2024 bleaching
items.summary: A new survey found coral cover across all three regions of the Great Barrier Reef stayed level or grew slightly over the past year. Scientists say a late monsoon cooled the water and limited bleaching, giving the reef its first real chance to recover since the twenty twenty four mass bleaching event.
items.why_it_matters: It shows the reef can begin bouncing back from mass bleaching when it gets even a brief break from ocean heat.
